Regular as clockwork, Apple holds an event in early September to launch new iPhone models and other products. Apple has just confirmed that this will be the case for 2026's presentation.

Titled "Surprise and shine," the event will be taking place on September 9, starting at 10 A.M. Pacific, 1 P.M. Eastern Time. As usual, it will be streamed on YouTube, the Apple Event page, and the Apple TV app, among other methods. [...] The September event is chiefly when Apple launches its update to the iPhone range, and this year it is the iPhone 18 generation. However, it will only be part of the roster due to Apple's decision to split the series into two separate launches.

Apple announced Wednesday that it is holding a launch event at its headquarters in Cupertino, California, on Sept. 9.

Invites sent to the media include the tagline "Surprise and shine" and a glowing Apple logo. The event kicks off at 10 a.m. Pacific time.

Analysts expect the company to launch new iPhones and Apple Watches at the event, including the company's first folding phone. Apple announced new Mac Mini and Mac Studio models this week that will ship on Sept. 22. [...] Key Points
